notes: Do not label a host C test, byte-identical source, scalar-only AOT, or LLVM linker build as cross-backend actor-executed parity.
LLVM tenant VM must report return/result evidence independently of GraalVM's synchronous-only pilot; missing instrumentation remains NOT_OBSERVED.
Actions on PR merge refs or incomplete/check-skipped jobs are not accepted as exact source-head guest proof.

This contract records the restricted M4 baseline only; completed historical run details are in the referenced immutable evidence record. Later hardening PRs require their own exact-head execution and do not retroactively certify the old runs.
OBSERVED_SOURCE_COMPILED_GUEST_NARROW_SCOPE is not equivalent independent scheduling, full language parity, production hostile tenant isolation or sustained zero-GC heap boundedness.
